description:
The United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) - Rock Island District intends to issue a solicitation for mowing and trimming services at Thomson Causeway Recreation Area in Thomson, Illinois. This is a pre-solicitation notice and is NOT a request for quotations.

The contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, materials/supplies, transportation and fuel to perform mowing and trimming services at Thomson Causeway Recreation Area.  Additional information on requirement will be provided when solicitation is released.
